# eon_action_approval_rule (Resource)

Manages an action approval rule: a durable multi-party approval (MPA) policy that requires one or more approvals before a sensitive operation can run. `operation` selects the protected action; optional `resource_selector` narrows which resources the rule applies to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Require approval before adding a restore account
resource "eon_action_approval_rule" "add_restore_account" {
  operation              = "ADD_RESTORE_ACCOUNT"
  required_approvals     = 1
  approval_window_hours  = 24
  execution_window_hours = 4
  description            = "Require approval before connecting a restore account"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `approval_window_hours` (Number) Hours the request stays open for approval before expiring.
- `execution_window_hours` (Number) Hours after approval during which the approved action can be executed.
- `operation` (String) Protected operation. Supported values: `ADD_RESTORE_ACCOUNT`, `CREATE_BACKUP_POLICY`, `RESTORE_RESOURCE`, `UPDATE_BACKUP_POLICY`, `DELETE_BACKUP_POLICY`, `REMOVE_SNAPSHOT_HOLD`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `approver_idp_id` (String) UUID of the SAML identity provider connection the approver group belongs to.
- `approver_provider_group_id` (String) Provider group identifier from the IdP whose members may approve.
- `description` (String) Optional description explaining the purpose of this rule.
- `exempt_api_credentials` (Boolean) When true, API credential users bypass this approval rule.
- `required_approvals` (Number) Number of approvals required before the action can be executed. Defaults to `1`.
- `resource_selector` (Attributes) Selects the resources this rule applies to. Omit to leave resource scoping unset (operation-dependent). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_selector))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the action approval rule.

<a id="nestedatt--resource_selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_selector`

Required:

- `resource_selection_mode` (String) How the rule selects resources. Supported values: `ALL`, `NONE`, `CONDITIONAL`. `CONDITIONAL` requires `expression`.

Optional:

- `expression` (Attributes) Condition selecting the resources this rule applies to. Set exactly one attribute; use `group` to combine conditions with `AND`/`OR`. Required when `resource_selection_mode` is `CONDITIONAL`, ignored otherwise. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_selector--expression))
- `resource_exclusion_override` (List of String) Resource identifiers to exclude regardless of `resource_selection_mode`.
- `resource_inclusion_override` (List of String) Resource identifiers to include regardless of `resource_selection_mode`.
